description: This file defines a PHP API endpoint class 'ValidationCustomerNameAPI' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the 'Time' module. The class handles validation of customer names for uniqueness, providing a GET endpoint to verify if a customer name can be used. It uses traits and services for customer data access and validation rules, and includes detailed documentation annotations for API consumers.

classes.description: An API endpoint class for validating customer names in the OrangeHRM Time module, ensuring uniqueness and handling validation rules.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate if a customer name is available (not taken). It optionally checks for a customer ID to exclude from the check and returns whether the name can be changed.
